title: A message gets edited
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: In this schematic example the intron UUU is removed and exons ACG and GGA are joined. Real splice sites are specified by surrounding sequence signals and machinery.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: In this schematic example the intron UUU is removed and exons ACG and GGA are joined. Real splice sites are specified by surrounding sequence signals and machinery.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A simplified RNA has exon ACG, an intron UUU, then exon GGA. If the intron is removed, what remains in this example? In this schematic example the intron UUU is removed and exons ACG and GGA are joined. Real splice sites are specified by surrounding sequence signals and machinery.
Recall: What is removed in the illustrated simple splicing example? The example removes the intron and joins the exons.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.
